brython_stdlib_lumen.js is a subset of Brython's brython_stdlib.js (the 44 modules listed in its "scripts" object,
unchanged), extracted for Lumen Convert by tools/deps/convert/build-brython-subset.js. The modules come from
the Python Standard Library (Python Software Foundation License) as packaged by Brython.
